annotations.text:
Split pane, not a separate page.

Today every open is a navigation and every back is another. A reading pane on the right lets you walk the list with the keyboard and never leave the screen — the single biggest change here.

Still missing: keyboard.

Nothing on these artboards shows it, but j/k to move, e to archive, r to reply and / to search matter more day to day than any of the visuals. Worth doing first.

Conventions, not Gmail's look.

Wide search bar, compose pill, dense rows, hover actions, floating composer — shared mail-client anatomy. The type, colour and spacing are your app's own tokens: Instrument Sans, the stone scale, sky accent, 6px radii.

The phone case is currently broken, not just unstyled.

The sidebar is hidden below md with nothing in its place, so on a phone there is no compose, no view switcher and no account switcher at all. Drawer plus a compose button fixes it.
